verdicts.reason: Flags §3 and proposes need-to-know disclosure restricted to affiliates, contractors, and advisors bound by written confidentiality obligations at least as protective.
Flags §5 and replaces two years with five years, preserving trade-secret obligations for as long as information remains a trade secret.
Flags §8 as prohibited by the playbook and proposes deletion or replacement with an intentionally omitted placeholder.
Identifies both missing provisions and accepts §1, but explicitly treats §10 as only partly compliant, leaving its forum provision unresolved.
Explicitly presented as a draft for attorney review, not legal advice; judgment calls go to supervising counsel, with no invented authorities.
